name: Corpselight Mist AP OLD
description: Churning vapors of glowing green mist fill a 30-foot-deep chasm.
disable: DC 28 Religion to counteract Kabriri's influence here by offering prayers to any non-evil deity and causing the mist to disperse, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the mist for 24 hours
reset: The hazard resets automatically at the end of a turn and can trigger again the next round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Decay Flesh
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature ends its turn within the mist

Effect The mist swiftly decays the flesh of all living creatures in the pit, inflicting 10d6 Void Damage damage (Basic DC 27 Fortitude Saving Throw save).
